The game includes Express Collect™ for instant prize collection, a Wheel Bonus that can award jackpots or trigger the Link&Win™ hold-and-spin feature, and Free Spins with retriggering capability.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Free Spins Scatter, Prize, Wheel Bonus, and Trigger symbols. Does not appear on reel 1.

symbols.name: Free Spins Scatter
symbols.description: Appears on reels 2, 3, and 4. Three symbols trigger 10 Free Spins.

symbols.name: Prize Symbol
symbols.description: Express Collect™ Prize symbols appear on reels 1-4 displaying credit values or Major/Mini prizes.

symbols.name: Trigger Symbol
symbols.description: Appears on reel 5 to activate Express Collect™ or Wheel Bonus features.

symbols.name: Wheel Bonus Symbol
symbols.description: Appears on reel 1 and triggers Wheel Bonus when combined with Trigger symbol on reel 5.

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: 3 Free Spins Scatter symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4 trigger 10 Free Spins. Can be retriggered and played on different reel set from base game.

feature_details.name: Collect Feature
feature_details.description: Land Express Collect™ Prize symbols on reels 1-4 and a Trigger symbol on reel 5 to collect displayed prize values including credit values or Major/Mini prizes.

feature_details.name: Hold and Spin
feature_details.description: Triggered through Wheel Bonus, begins with 3 spins where Link&Win™ symbols are held and remaining positions spin. Additional symbols reset spins to 3. 15 symbols awards Mega prize.

feature_details.name: Wheel
feature_details.description: Triggered by Wheel Bonus symbol on reel 1 and Trigger symbol on reel 5. Spins once to award prizes including Mega/Major/Mini prizes, Link&Win™ feature, or multipliers.

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.context: Throughout Wheel Bonus and Link&Win™ sections
feature_details.description: Fixed jackpot tiers (Mega, Major, Mini) available through various features including Express Collect™, Wheel Bonus, and Link&Win™.

name: 5 Treasures Jackpot Festival
description: 5 Treasures Jackpot Festival is an Asian-themed 5-reel, 243 ways slot featuring progressive jackpots and multiple bonus features. Players can trigger Free Spins with five different modes, each offering varying symbol frequencies, and the FU BABY™ Jackpot pick bonus for additional winning opportunities.

symbols.name: FU BAT
symbols.description: Wild symbol that substitutes for all symbols except DRAGON WITH OVERLAY, appears on reels 2, 3, and 4

symbols.name: TREASURE DOOR
symbols.description: Scatter symbol that triggers Free Spins when 3 or more appear on consecutive reels starting from the first reel

symbols.name: DRAGON WITH OVERLAY
symbols.description: Special symbols that substitute for DRAGON symbols and can award fixed jackpots when 4 or 5 appear adjacently

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: 3 or more TREASURE DOOR symbols on consecutive reels starting from the first reel award 6 Free Spins. Player must select one of five Free Spin modes, each featuring different symbol frequencies.

feature_details.name: Pick Bonus
feature_details.description: May trigger when 1 or more FU BAT symbols appear on screen. Coins are displayed and player picks to reveal FU BABY™ symbols until 3 matching symbols are revealed.

feature_details.name: Progressive Jackpot
feature_details.description: Grand, Major, and Minor jackpots are progressive and constantly accumulating. Funded by a percentage of player wagers with values displayed in game.

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.description: Mini jackpot is fixed based on stake. Additionally, 4 DRAGON WITH OVERLAY symbols award 888x stake, and 5 award the Jackpot Festival™ Jackpot.

name: Tsai Shen 10k Ways
description: Tsai Shen 10K Ways is an Asian-themed slot with 10,000 ways to win across 6 reels. Features cascading reels, hold and spin bonus respins, and a Fortune Bonus pick game with jackpots up to 10,000x bet.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except scatter, appears on top reel only

symbols.name: Scatter
symbols.description: 6 or more trigger the Bonus Respins feature, award prizes when collected

feature_details.name: Cascading Reels
feature_details.context: GAME RULES section - 'Every winning symbol (except SCATTER) explodes and is replaced by symbols coming from above'
feature_details.description: After wins, winning symbols explode and are replaced by new symbols falling from above, creating potential chain wins.

feature_details.name: Hold and Spin
feature_details.description: 6 or more scatter symbols trigger a bonus where scatters lock in place and remaining positions respin. New scatters reset the counter to 3 respins.

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.context: FORTUNE BONUS section with named prize tiers
feature_details.description: A pick bonus that awards fixed jackpot tiers: Mini (10x), Minor (25x), Major (100x), Grand (1000x), and 10K Bonus (10000x).

feature_details.name: Pick Bonus
feature_details.context: FORTUNE BONUS section - 'A set of 15 coins is presented. Continue to select Coins'
feature_details.description: Player selects from 15 coins to reveal prizes. The first prize revealed three times is awarded.

feature_details.name: Persistence
feature_details.context: FORTUNE BONUS section - 'Every game played contributes to the Coin Stack. Coin Stack is accumulated separately per bet level'
feature_details.description: A coin stack accumulates across base game spins and can trigger the Fortune Bonus when filled or randomly.

name: Super 50 Stars
description: Super 50 Stars is a classic 7s-themed 5x3 slot with 30 paylines featuring a unique Hold and Spin minigame, crystal symbol transformations, and respin mechanics with progressive multipliers.

symbols.name: Super 25 Stars
symbols.description: Wild symbol that appears on reel 3, triggers respins when creating wins, and advances multiplier panel

symbols.name: Super 50 Symbol
symbols.description: Triggers the Super 50 Gold minigame when landing completely, transforms into 3 Super 50 coins

symbols.name: Bonus
symbols.description: Appears on reels 2, 3, and 4, offers a win equal to the spin cost without needing to be on a payline

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: The game includes a free spins feature as mentioned in the rules.

feature_details.name: Hold and Spin
feature_details.description: A 3x3 grid minigame where Super 50 coins lock in place and respins are awarded. Collector coins in the central reel accumulate values from coins on reels 1 and 3. Each new coin resets respins to 3.
characteristics: Respins reset to 3 with new coins

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.description: The minigame features named jackpot tiers: Minor, Major, or Grand win coins that can appear during the hold and spin feature.

feature_details.name: Respin
feature_details.context: H3 SUPER 25 STARS WILD SYMBOL section
feature_details.description: When the Super 25 Stars wild creates a win, winning symbols are held and a respin is triggered. This continues until no new winning combinations appear.

feature_details.name: Symbol Transformation
feature_details.description: A feature where glowing stars indicate a position, and the symbol at that intersection becomes crystallized. All matching symbols on the reels then transform into crystal symbols with multipliers applied.
characteristics: Crystal symbols pay anywhere on lines

name: Colt Lightning Firestorm
description: Colt Lightning Firestorm is a 5-reel Western-themed slot with 1024 ways to win that can expand to 3125 during Fire Free Spins. The game features the Lightning Blaze symbol transformation mechanic and a Firestorm Feature that combines instant multiplier prizes with expanded grid free spins.

symbols.name: WILD
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except SCATTERS and HORSESHOE, appears on reels 2, 3 and 4 only

symbols.name: HORSESHOE
symbols.description: Appears only on reel 3 and triggers the LIGHTNING BLAZE feature with symbol transformation

symbols.name: FIRESTORM SCATTER
symbols.description: 3 on reels 2, 3, and 4 trigger the FIRESTORM FEATURE

symbols.name: FIRE BALL SCATTER
symbols.description: Awards +1 extra FREE SPIN during FIRE FREE SPINS, up to maximum of 46

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Triggered by 3 FIRESTORM SCATTERS on reels 2, 3, and 4 as part of the FIRESTORM FEATURE. Awards 8 initial free spins with expanded grid and transformed COLT symbols that pay double.

feature_details.name: Symbol Transformation
feature_details.description: When HORSESHOE symbol lands on reel 3, it triggers LIGHTNING BLAZE where 3 to 20 FIRE FRAMES randomly appear and symbols within transform into one type of animal symbol.

name: Blazing Mammoth
description: Blazing Mammoth is a 5-reel, 3-row video slot with 20 paylines featuring mammoth symbols and fire themes. The game includes Free Spins triggered by scatter symbols with multiplier wheels, and bonus features with mammoth symbols that can randomly trigger for additional wins.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Scatter and Mammoth symbols, can form own winning combinations

symbols.name: Scatter
symbols.description: Appears on reels 2, 3, and 4 only, triggers Free Spins wheel when 3 land, wins multiplied by total bet

symbols.name: Mammoth
symbols.description: Three or more anywhere pay out bonus wins multiplied by total bet, can randomly trigger in base game and Free Spins

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: 3 Scatter symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4 trigger a Free Spins wheel that awards 10-30 spins with X2 or X3 multiplier. Can retrigger for additional spins.

feature_details.name: Wheel
feature_details.description: When Free Spins are triggered, a wheel spins once to award a combination of number of spins (10-30) and multiplier (X2 or X3).

name: Slot Vegas
description: Slot Vegas features four 4-reel video slots with 256 ways to win each, combining for unique multi-slot gameplay. The Rainbow Wild Bonus merges adjacent slots into an 8-reel configuration with up to 65,536 ways to win, while progressive Symbol Multipliers enhance Diamond and Lucky Seven wins.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Regular Wilds substitute for all symbols except Scatter and Rainbow Wilds, appearing on reels 2, 3 and 4

symbols.name: Rainbow Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Scatter, appears on reels 2 and 3, triggers the Rainbow Wild Bonus when appearing in adjacent video slots

symbols.name: Scatter
symbols.description: 4 or more Scatters across all four video slots trigger Free Spins, awarding 6 Free Spins plus 3 for each additional Scatter

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Triggered by 4 or more Scatters across all four video slots, awarding 6 Free Spins plus 3 for each additional Scatter. Free Spins use two 4-reel video slots with 4,096 ways to win each.

name: Prosperity Pearls
description: A 5x5 grid slot with 25 independent reels requiring at least 10 identical symbols for wins. Features Hold the Jackpot bonus with pearl value accumulation mechanics and variable volatility levels.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Bonus symbols, is also a paying symbol

symbols.name: White Pearl
symbols.description: Bonus symbol with bet multiplier values x1-x10, contributes to gold and black pearl calculations

symbols.name: Gold Pearl
symbols.description: Bonus symbol whose value equals sum of all white pearl symbols on reels when drawn

symbols.name: Black Pearl
symbols.description: Bonus symbol whose value is doubled sum of all white, gold and black pearls on reels when drawn

symbols.name: Mystery
symbols.description: Bonus symbol that can take value of other Bonus symbols including pearls or jackpot symbols, drawn at end of bonus

feature_details.name: Hold and Spin
feature_details.description: Triggered by 6+ Bonus symbols, locks symbols in place and awards 3 respins that reset to 3 when new Bonus symbols land. Features white, gold, and black pearl symbols with different value mechanics.
characteristics: GRAND prize for filling all positions

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.context: Hold the Jackpot Bonus section and paytable references
feature_details.description: Fixed jackpot tiers including MINI, MINOR, MAJOR, and GRAND prizes. GRAND is awarded when all 25 positions are filled with Bonus symbols.

feature_details.name: Respin
feature_details.description: Drawing 3, 4 or 5 Bonus symbols in base game triggers a paid re-spin with Bonus symbols blocked on reels to increase chances of activating Hold the Jackpot.

feature_details.name: Buy Bonus
feature_details.description: Shop feature allows players to buy one of the bonuses available in the game for direct entry.

feature_details.name: Gamble Feature
feature_details.description: Players can risk any win for a chance to double it by selecting one of two symbols. Feature has seven rounds and player can end after each round.

name: Piggy Prizes Wand Of Riches
description: A magic-themed slot featuring a Magician who unlocks coin and jackpot prizes from locked symbols. The game includes persistent piggy pots that fill up over time and explode to award Free Games with sticky wilds and instant prize collection.

symbols.name: Magician
symbols.description: Acts as Wild substitute and unlocks coin/jackpot symbols. Appears only on center reel and becomes sticky during Free Games.

symbols.name: Locked Coin
symbols.description: Credit prize symbols that are locked with chains and padlocks, unlocked by Magician symbol.

symbols.name: Fixed Pot
symbols.description: Jackpot symbols that are locked with chains and padlocks, unlocked by Magician symbol.

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Triggered when piggy filler pots reach maximum size and explode, awarding 6 Free Games per pig. During Free Games, the Magician symbol becomes sticky on the center reel and all coins/jackpots that land are instantly awarded.

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.context: Main Game section describing locked pot symbols
feature_details.description: Fixed pot symbols with jackpot values are locked on reels and can be won when the Magician symbol lands on the center reel position to unlock them.

feature_details.name: Cash On Reels
feature_details.context: Main Game section describing locked coin symbols
feature_details.description: Coin symbols with credit values appear locked on reels and are unlocked and awarded when the Magician symbol lands on the center reel position.

feature_details.name: Nudges
feature_details.description: The center reel may rewind a random number of positions to land on the Magician symbol. Non-winning symbols may also rewind to land on locked jackpot symbols.

feature_details.name: Persistence
feature_details.context: Free Games section describing pot filling mechanism
feature_details.description: Two piggy filler pots progressively fill up when the Magician symbol adds coins to them across base game spins. When pots reach maximum size, they explode to trigger Free Games.

name: Precious Panda Hold And Win
description: Precious Panda Hold and Win is a 5x3 Asian-themed slot featuring pandas and traditional symbols. The game offers a unique Panda Feature Pick where players choose between Free Spins with extra wilds or the Hold & Win Feature with cash medallions and jackpot prizes up to 1000x bet.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Cash Medallion and Bonus symbols. Can become stacked on reels 2-5, counting as 3 single wilds when stacked.

symbols.name: Bonus
symbols.description: Three Bonus symbols on reels 1, 3, and 5 trigger the Panda Feature Pick. Also retriggers Free Spins during the feature.

symbols.name: Cash Medallion
symbols.description: Displays cash values from 1x to 500x bet or jackpot tiers. Five or more trigger Hold & Win Feature where they lock in place for respins.

symbols.name: Fortune Chime
symbols.description: Randomly triggered feature that reveals instant cash prizes of 8x, 88x, 888x, or 8888x bet.

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Awards 8, 10, or 12 free spins with 25-100 additional wild symbols added to the reels. Wild symbols can become stacked on reels 2-5 during free spins.

feature_details.name: Hold and Spin
feature_details.description: Triggered by 5+ Cash Medallion symbols, awards 3 respins with cash values locked in place. New Cash Medallions reset respins to 3.
characteristics: grand prize if all spaces filled

feature_details.name: Pick Bonus
feature_details.description: Player picks a panda to reveal either Free Spins or Hold & Win Feature. 60/40 probability favoring Free Spins.
characteristics: choose between free spins or hold & win

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.context: Section 3.7 Hold & Win Feature jackpot values
feature_details.description: Fixed jackpot tiers: Mini (30x), Minor (100x), Major (500x), and Grand (1000x) total bet available during Hold & Win Feature.

feature_details.name: Cash On Reels
feature_details.description: Cash Medallion symbols land with random values from 1x to 500x bet. Special jackpot medallions (Mini, Minor, Major) can also land.

name: Rich Little Hens World Class
description: Rich Little Hens World Class is an animal-themed slot featuring Mystery Stacked Reels that reveal various symbols and coin types. The game offers multiple persistent meters that accumulate values across spins, leading to different free spins variations and a wheel bonus feature with six jackpot tiers.

symbols.name: WILD
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except coins

symbols.name: MYSTERY SYMBOL
symbols.description: Transforms into wilds, premium symbols, or reveals coin symbols before pays are evaluated

symbols.name: RED COIN
symbols.description: Triggers Free Spins Feature or adds spins to RED HEN meter

symbols.name: YELLOW COIN
symbols.description: Triggers Free Spins Feature or adds values to jackpot meters

symbols.name: PURPLE COIN
symbols.description: Triggers Free Spins Feature or increases roaming mystery symbols

symbols.name: WHITE COIN
symbols.description: Triggers Wheel Bonus Feature or upgrades free spins during features

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Any combination of RED COIN, YELLOW COIN, PURPLE COIN may trigger the Free Spins Feature and award 1x total bet. Different coin combinations trigger different variations of free spins with unique mechanics.

feature_details.name: Mystery Symbols
feature_details.description: During the base game, all MYSTERY SYMBOL will be replaced with WILD, premium symbols, or coin symbols before pays are evaluated. May also reveal coin symbols on top of replaced symbols.
characteristics: Reveals wilds, premium symbols, or coins
Can reveal multiple coin types simultaneously

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.operator_name: MEGA, GRAND, MAJOR, MAXI, MINOR, MINI
feature_details.context: Throughout FREE SPINS FEATURE and WHEEL BONUS FEATURE sections
feature_details.description: Six named jackpot tiers (MEGA, GRAND, MAJOR, MAXI, MINOR, MINI) that can be won through the Wheel Bonus Feature or collected during YELLOW HEN free spins.
characteristics: Collected via jackpot symbols in YELLOW HEN free spins

feature_details.name: Wheel
feature_details.description: WHITE COIN may trigger the Wheel Bonus Feature which awards wheel spins. The wheel awards total bet prizes, MEGA, GRAND, or Free Spins Feature with additional wheel spins for non-free spins results.
characteristics: Awards cash prizes, jackpots, or free spins

feature_details.name: Cash On Reels
feature_details.operator_name: Coin symbols (RED COIN, YELLOW COIN, PURPLE COIN, WHITE COIN)
feature_details.context: Throughout Mystery Stacked Reels™ and feature descriptions
feature_details.description: Four different colored coin symbols with credit values that appear on reels and trigger various features. Each coin type has distinct functions - triggering free spins, adding to meters, or triggering wheel bonus.
characteristics: Four coin types with different functions
RED: adds free spins to meter
YELLOW: adds values to jackpot meters
WHITE: triggers wheel bonus or upgrades

feature_details.name: Persistence
feature_details.operator_name: Meters (RED HEN, YELLOW HEN, PURPLE HEN meters)
feature_details.description: Multiple persistent meters track accumulated values across base game spins. RED HEN meter accumulates free spins, YELLOW HEN tracks jackpot progress, PURPLE HEN counts roaming mystery symbols.
characteristics: RED HEN meter: accumulates up to 40 free spins
YELLOW HEN meter: fills jackpot spaces
PURPLE HEN meter: up to 6 roaming mystery symbols

name: Piggy Bonanza
description: Piggy Bonanza is a 5x3 ways-to-win slot featuring a pig theme with multiple collection mechanics. The game includes a Piggy Booster meter that persists across spins, various bonus features triggered through symbol collection, and expanding reels that can grow the grid during bonus play.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Bonus, Cash Coin, Cash Diamond, and Collect symbols. Appears on reels 1, 2, 4, 5 in base game only.

symbols.name: Bonus
symbols.description: Triggers the Bonus feature when 3 land on reels 1, 3, and 5. Also contributes to Piggy Booster meter when landing on reels 1 and 3.

symbols.name: Cash Coin
symbols.description: Value symbols ranging from 1x to 200x bet. Can be collected by Collect symbol in base game or remain locked during Bonus feature.

symbols.name: Cash Diamond
symbols.description: Value symbols that trigger Diamond Respin when appearing on reels 1 and 5. Values range from 1x to 200x bet.

symbols.name: Collect
symbols.description: Appears only on reel 5 in base game. Collects and awards the sum of all Cash Coin values when it lands with Cash Coins on the same spin.

feature_details.name: Cash On Reels
feature_details.context: Cash Coin symbols section and Collect feature description
feature_details.description: Cash Coin symbols with values from 1x to 200x bet can land on reels 1-4 in base game and are collected by the Collect symbol.

feature_details.name: Collect Feature
feature_details.description: Triggered when a Collect symbol lands on reel 5 with at least one Cash Coin symbol on the same spin. Awards sum of all Cash Coin values.

feature_details.name: Expanding Reels
feature_details.context: Bonus section describing Expander collection feature
feature_details.description: During Bonus, the Expander feature adds extra rows - first trigger adds one row above, second trigger adds one row below the base 5x3 grid.

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Triggered by 3 Bonus symbols on reels 1, 3, and 5. Awards 3 bonus spins initially, with respins awarded when Cash Coin or Collection symbols land.

feature_details.name: Nudges
feature_details.description: Piggy can nudge reel 5 to reveal a Collect symbol when Cash Coin symbols are present but no Collect symbol landed.

feature_details.name: Persistence
feature_details.description: Meter that collects tokens during base game and carries over between spins. Tokens are converted to Collection tokens before Bonus starts.

feature_details.name: Respin
feature_details.description: Triggered by Cash Diamond symbols on reels 1 and 5. Awards one respin with chance for Cash Coins, 1UP multiplier symbols, or blanks.

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.context: Bonus section describing Prizer collection feature
feature_details.description: Prizer collection feature awards fixed Diamond values of 15x, 50x, 200x, and 1000x bet on 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th triggers respectively.

name: Sisters Of Oz Jackpots
description: Sisters of Oz Jackpots is a 5x4 reel slot featuring Free Spins with 2x multipliers and Jumbo Blocks. The Jackpot Wheel awards one of four guaranteed jackpots when triggered by collecting special symbols.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Acts as both wild and scatter symbol. Substitutes for all symbols except Jackpot Trigger. 3+ trigger free spins and award scatter pays.

symbols.name: Jackpot Trigger
symbols.description: Collecting these symbols grants a chance of triggering the Jackpot Wheel feature.

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: 3, 4, or 5 scatters trigger 5, 7, or 10 free spins respectively. Line wins are multiplied by x2 in Free Spins.
characteristics: Jumbo Blocks appear on every spin

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.description: A wheel feature that awards 1 of 4 guaranteed jackpots. Triggered by collecting Jackpot Trigger symbols.

feature_details.name: Colossal Symbols
feature_details.description: Symbol stacks can combine on the 3 centre reels to form Jumbo Blocks. A full Jumbo Block spans 3 x 4 positions.

name: Azteca Bonus Lines
description: Azteca Bonus Lines is a 5-reel, 10-line Aztec-themed slot featuring the Bonus Lines system where special symbols on reel 5 multiply prizes by winning lines. The game offers cash awards, free spins with locked wilds, and a Prize Boost feature with three fixed jackpot tiers.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Cash, Free Games Coin, and Prizes symbols. Locks on reel 3 during free games.

symbols.name: Cash
symbols.description: Contains cash values (x1-x10) and awards prizes when landing on reel 5 with winning lines, multiplied by number of winning lines.

symbols.name: Free Games Coin
symbols.description: Contains free games values (+1 to +10) and awards free spins when landing on reel 5 with winning lines, multiplied by winning lines.

symbols.name: Prizes
symbols.description: Diamond symbol that triggers Prize Boost when landing on reel 5, awarding random GRAND, MAJOR, or MINOR prizes multiplied by winning lines.

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.context: Section under 'Bonus Lines™ Free Games Feature'
feature_details.description: Triggered by Free Games Coin symbols landing on reel 5 with winning lines. Awards the number of free games shown on the coin multiplied by winning lines.
characteristics: Wild locked on reel 3 during free spins
Additional free spins awarded during feature

feature_details.name: Cash On Reels
feature_details.context: Section under 'Bonus Lines Collect' and 'Bonus Lines™ Feature'
feature_details.description: Cash symbols with values (x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x10) land on reel 5 and award cash prizes multiplied by the number of winning lines.
characteristics: Values range from x1 to x10
Multiplied by number of winning lines

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.description: Prize symbols on reel 5 trigger Prize Boost, awarding GRAND, MAJOR, or MINOR fixed prizes randomly selected and multiplied by winning lines.
characteristics: Three named tiers: GRAND, MAJOR, MINOR

name: Fu Nan Fu Nu
description: Fu Nan Fu Nu is an Asian-themed slot featuring PowerXStream ways evaluation. The game offers a Free Spins Bonus with player choice options and bet multiplier rewards, plus a Jackpot Pick Bonus where wilds can trigger a pick feature to win fixed jackpot prizes.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols and appears on reels 2, 3 and 4 only. Can trigger Jackpot Pick Bonus.

symbols.name: Gong
symbols.description: Winning combination triggers 10 free spins bonus.

symbols.name: Gold Coins
symbols.description: Awards additional bet multipliers during free spins (5x, 10x, or 50x based on quantity).

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Triggered by winning combination of Gong symbols, awards 10 free spins with additional bet multipliers for 3-5 Gold Coins. Player can choose from 3 different free spins bonus options.

feature_details.name: Pick Bonus
feature_details.description: Mystery triggered when wild lands in base game. Player picks from 12 objects to reveal jackpot icons until 3 matching icons award the corresponding jackpot.

feature_details.name: Static Jackpot
feature_details.description: Fixed jackpot prizes awarded through the pick bonus feature when player matches 3 jackpot icons.

name: Miss Midas
description: Miss Midas is a 5-reel, 25-line slot featuring the SUPERBET™ system and Miss Midas Magic Touch Feature where adjacent symbols transform to GOLD. The game includes Free Games triggered by CASTLE scatters and an optional gamble feature for additional winning opportunities.

symbols.name: MISS MIDAS
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except scatter, appears on reel 3 only, can turn adjacent symbols to GOLD

symbols.name: GOLD
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except scatter, created by Miss Midas transformation

symbols.name: CASTLE
symbols.description: Scatter symbol that triggers Free Game Feature, pays anywhere, awards 15-25 free games

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.context: H2 section titled FREE GAME FEATURE
feature_details.description: 15, 20 or 25 Free Games are awarded when 3, 4 or 5 CASTLE symbols appear respectively. Free Games can be retriggered and are played at the lines and bet of the trigger game.
characteristics: Variable awards based on trigger count

feature_details.name: Symbol Transformation
feature_details.context: H2 section titled MISS MIDAS MAGIC TOUCH FEATURE and SUPERBET™ section
feature_details.description: MISS MIDAS can turn adjacent symbols to GOLD. The symbols that can be transformed depend on the SUPERBET level - from just PEACOCK and THRONE at base level, up to PEACOCK, THRONE, FRUIT, and ROSE at maximum SUPERBET level.

feature_details.name: Gamble Feature
feature_details.context: H2 section titled GAMBLE FEATURE (IF APPLICABLE)
feature_details.description: Players can gamble any win by selecting RED/BLACK (doubles win) or a SUIT (quadruples win). Winnings may be gambled up to 5 times, but Progressive Jackpot wins cannot be gambled.

name: Lucky Gift Collect Em
description: Lucky Gift Collect'Em is a 6-reel, 50-line slot featuring cascading reels and a unique collect mechanic. Collect'Em symbols gather cash prizes, free games, and diamonds, with a special dual-grid free spins bonus and four-tier jackpot system.

symbols.name: Wild
symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Collect'Em, Cash Prize, Diamond, and Free Games symbols. Appears on reels 2-6.

symbols.name: Collect'Em
symbols.description: Collector symbol that gathers all prize symbols on the same spin. Appears on reels 1&6 in base game, all reels in Free Games.

symbols.name: Cash Prize
symbols.description: Envelope symbols containing bet multipliers (x1 to x10). Collected by Collect'Em symbols.

symbols.name: Diamond
symbols.description: Special symbol that triggers jackpot prizes when collected by Collect'Em symbols.

symbols.name: Free Games
symbols.description: Symbols with +numbers that award free spins when collected. Values include +1, +2, +3, +5.

feature_details.name: Cascading Reels
feature_details.description: Any winning combination triggers the reels to cascade. All winning combinations explode after paying out, allowing new symbols to drop in for additional wins.

feature_details.name: Collect Feature
feature_details.description: Collect'Em™ symbols on reels 1 and 6 collect all prize symbols (Cash Prize, Diamond, Free Games) that land on the same spin.

feature_details.name: Free Spins

name: Arctic Enchantress

name: Mad Hit Wild Alice

Players can buy direct entry to free games or trigger features through Prize symbols with various values.

symbols.name: Wild

symbols.name: Prize
symbols.description: Contains credit values, free games numbers, or jackpot triggers, works with Mad Hit to activate features

feature_details.name: Free Spins
feature_details.description: Triggered when Mad Hit lands with Prize symbols showing Free Games values. Mad Hit becomes sticky for duration of feature.

feature_details.name: Buy Bonus

name: Roller Wheel Jungle Roll

The main feature is the Roller Wheel bonus triggered by 3 scatter symbols, offering various prizes including free spins, wild spins, and fixed jackpots. Rolling Reveal mystery symbols add an element of transformation to the gameplay.

name: Tikaani Gold

name: Midnight Princess
